description: Search Amazon for first-apartment / housewarming essentials on the user's marketplace. Returns PA-API products when configured, otherwise search deep-link cards (buyUrl, trackingTag) + catalogMatches. ALWAYS pass marketplace + locale. OpenAPI: searchAmazon.

locale.description: User locale, e.g. en, sv, de, fr, es

marketplace.description: Amazon storefront domain or id for the end user, e.g. amazon.se, amazon.com, se, de. REQUIRED.

q.description: Search query, e.g. kitchen starter kit

roomFocus.description: kitchen | bathroom | sleep | laundry | cleaning | lighting | storage

name: search_kits
title: Search housewarming kits
